In short
Tell the agent which command must pass and that it must fix the code, not the tests.
Mel reads the test command from AGENTS.md and uses it to check its work.
For a big red suite, ask for one cause at a time or let a lead agent split the work.
Read every test change on the approval card before you allow it.
To fix failing tests with an AI agent, tell it which command must pass and what it may not touch, then let it run that command itself. In Mel – the agentic terminal (openmel.dev), put your test command in AGENTS.md or MEL.md, attach the failing output with Ctrl+↑ (⌃↑ on a Mac), and write a finish line such as "make pytest pass without skipping or deleting a test". Mel's agent reads the failing tests and the code, changes what it needs, and runs the tests again before it says it …

Investigating Suspected File Modification After a Serv-U Privilege Abuse


An alert on a Serv-U host does not prove that CVE-2026-82315 was exploited. It may be an approved change, a failed transfer, an administrator troubleshooting an issue, or another vulnerability. The investigation becomes manageable when the team separates a credible privileged-access event from confirmed file manipulation and confirmed system compromise.
SolarWinds describes CVE-2026-82315 as a TOCTOU flaw affecting Serv-U through 2026.3. A domain administrator or higher-privileged user may access or modify protected files outside the intended directory, potentially leading to code execution. The fixed release is 2026.4.
If a file outside the expected transfer path has changed, record its path, hash, size, timestamps…

Short answer: for a property-management app that uploads images directly from a browser, choose Cloudflare R2 when tenant-scoped object keys, S3 compatibility, and download egress are the deciding constraints. Choose Amazon S3 when you need the broadest ecosystem, high read throughput, or low egress is already true for your workload. Choose Wasabi when long-term storage matters more than global reach and free egress.
The important part is the boundary around each tenant. A presigned URL can move bytes from a browser to storage, but it does not decide whether the browser was allowed to request that key.
